prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Pet Generation in Progress", "Interact with your pet mascot and practice basic desktop companion care while we assemble your pet's custom graphics.", "Mascot Care Simulator", "Asset Generation Progress"]
1: ["Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "Scroll through animated companion interactions and listen to audio samples to discover your ideal companion style.", "Companion Greeting Audio Sample", "Interactive Companion Preview"]
2: ["Choose Your Pet's Desktop Personality", "Select whether you want a calm focus buddy or an energetic, playful pet that interacts with your open desktop windows.", "Desktop Personality Paths"]
3: ["Your Companion is Ready to Explore!", "You are all set. Use the system tray icon anytime to adjust pet visibility or summon your pet."]
4: ["Building desktop collision boundaries and rendering custom pet animations...", "Asset Generation Pipeline Status"]
5: ["Welcome Home! Starter Toy Unlocked", "To celebrate your new companion, we've placed a special interactive desktop toy in your tray inventory!", "Exclusive Starter Accessory Unlocked"]
6: ["Sign In to Save & Restore Your Pets", "Your account links your custom pets securely across app launches. Existing pets will automatically sync upon signing in.", "Make sure to use the same email or method you used previously."]
7: ["For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos with your subject centered and unobstructed.", "Tip: Avoid heavy filters or dark shadows for optimal 3D pet rendering."]
8: ["Feel free to minimize this window. We'll send a desktop notification when your pet is ready to land on your screen."]
9: ["Select Your Starter Companion", "Browse companion archetypes and choose the personality that best fits your desktop vibe.", "Personality & Desktop Vibe"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions gifts or free extra items ('Starter Toy Unlocked', 'Exclusive Starter Accessory')
